job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: This is a high-impact opportunity for an experienced quantitative professional who is motivated by developing, validating, and advancing machine learning models that detect and prevent fraud

You will work with large-scale transaction and application data to uncover emerging fraud patterns, engineer predictive features, develop and assess sophisticated models, and strengthen model performance from research through production implementation
The role combines hands-on model development with rigorous validation, documentation, governance, and partnership across fraud, technology, model risk, audit, and business teams

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex analytical problems, challenging model assumptions, translating technical findings for varied audiences, and seeing their work improve customer protection and business outcomes

In this role, you will: Lead the end-to-end development and enhancement of machine learning and statistical models used for real-time fraud risk assessment, transaction or application ranking, and fraud prevention

Analyze millions to billions of records in big data environments to identify predictive fraud signals, evolving attack patterns, and opportunities to reduce fraud losses while supporting a strong customer experience
Build robust Python-based modeling pipelines, including data preparation, sampling, feature engineering, feature selection, model training, testing, and performance evaluation

Apply and assess advanced techniques such as gradient boosting, random forests, isolation forests, support vector machines, neural networks, autoencoders, sequence models, and other fit-for-purpose approaches

Perform independent model validation and effective challenge by evaluating conceptual soundness, data quality, assumptions, methodology, implementation, performance, stability, limitations, and ongoing monitoring results

Design evaluation strategies using appropriate fraud-model measures, threshold analysis, out-of-time testing, back-testing, sensitivity analysis, and benchmarking to confirm models are reliable and fit for purpose
Lead debugging, testing, code review, and performance tuning for machine learning and statistical models developed in Python and distributed computing environments
Document model methodology, validation evidence, assumptions, limitations, controls, and performance outcomes in a clear, reproducible, and governance-ready manner

Present analytical findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, including fraud leaders, business stakeholders, model validation, model risk, internal audit, governance partners, and regulatory reviewers
Partner across business, technology, data, and risk teams to move analytically sound fraud solutions into production and ensure models continue to address changing fraud threats
Mentor or provide technical leadership to quantitative analysts and contribute to standards, reusable modeling practices, and a culture of analytical rigor
Perform targeted analysis and reporting in response to emerging fraud trends, model-performance questions, audit requests, or regulatory review needs
What makes this opportunity compelling Work on complex, high-value fraud problems where advanced analytics can directly strengthen customer protection
Influence both model innovation and model integrity through hands-on development, validation, governance, and production partnership
Collaborate with quantitative, fraud, technology, risk, audit, and business professionals across a large-scale financial services environment
Help shape how machine learning, AI, and emerging GenAI capabilities are responsibly applied to fraud detection and prevention

Experience developing, validating, or challenging fraud models across the model lifecycle, including data assessment, sampling, feature engineering, model design and specification, performance testing, implementation review, documentation, and ongoing monitoring
